writeup: Woot has the new DEWALT DW079LG 20V MAX green rotary laser kit for $935.99. The lowest in-stock price we found elsewhere is Wylaco Supply at $1,849, with Authorized Tool Outlet at $1,999, so this saves about $913. The kit matches model DW079LG and includes the detector, a 20V MAX battery, charger and TSTAK case. Woot shows only one left, with a limit of five per customer.
